```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The United States has an indispensable role to play in solving the climate crisis.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States has an obligation to help other nations carry out climate work.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America's leadership in domestic clean energy development is driving a global cycle of innovation and investment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This global cycle of innovation and investment will help lower the cost of clean energy technologies in a fair and transparent way for all nations.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"International climate finance is an important tool in fighting climate change.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration committed to achieve $11 billion dollars of climate financing a year by 2024.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This $11 billion in climate financing is to help develop the international clean energy market.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States worked with other nations to achieve a landmark global goal of mobilizing $100 billion in collective climate financing by 2022.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This $100 billion in collective climate financing fulfills a promise of the 2015 Paris Agreement.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will continue to support efforts to boost funding for PREPARE, a program to build out better early warning systems for climate impacts in critical regions of the globe.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will use its leadership to drive global innovation and build out clean energy supply chains.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will work through the Multilateral Development Bank to elevate climate and clean energy priorities within the global development finance system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will build on its leadership in innovative debt-for-nature swaps.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"These debt-for-nature swaps have helped countries from Barbados to Gabon to restructure over $2 billion in debt so far.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"These debt-for-nature swaps have unlocked hundreds of millions of dollars for nature and climate investments.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
